Name: Distillery
Author: Quirinea
Description:
Distillery adds two new machines to the game and a couple of new rules for Keg and Recycling machine. You get them when you have farming level 8 (i.e. when you can make kegs and have something to distill)

[b]Distillery[/b] itself makes strong alcoholic beverages from milder ones and juices(three bottles are required for one of the product):

Most wines are distilled into [i]liquour
[/i]Grape wine produces [i]Cognac .
[/i]Cactus fruit wine becomes [i]tequila añejo[/i].
Pale ale is distilled into [i]Malt Whisky
[/i]Beer is distilled into [i]Bourbon Whiskey 
[/i]Mead is distilled into Sun [i]Rum

[/i]There are two new keg produces:

[i]Mountain Sake[/i] from (milled rice), which can be further distilled into Rice Vodka

[i]Long drink[/i] from Snow Jam (some use for it!) which can be distilled into[i] Snow Gin[/i] (yes, I know it should be juniper, but there are none in the game; and I know the procedure is backwards anyway...)

Other juices can be distilled into Plain [i]Vodka [/i]with more or less success.

Corn juice and potato juice produce vodka almost always, Amaranth juice and beet juice almost as well, but other juices are more probable to become [i]Bootleg Liquor.

[/i]Normal distilling takes two hours, Bootleg Liquor pops out after half an hour. Bootleg Liquor is worthless but you can put it in the Recycling machine to get something hopefully a bit more useful...

As the function of Casks would be hard to reprogram, the aging of brandy etc. can be done in an [b]Iron Cask[/b].
After six weeks you have aged (iridium quality) liquour, cognac, whisky, rum or gin.

Gin needs a pine cone for flavour (the closest I could get to that juniper).

Iron cask can also be used to produce Wermut[i] [/i]from vodka.
Holly is used for seasoning this time (hey, I know that's not the correct spice, but again I wanted to use things that exist in the vanilla game (and especially have little use otherwise).

Thank you ErosDkAl for the graphics (added as I now finally make this new version)

Some translation lines added. There are Finnish and random German names

I've tried to further remove incompatibilities with PPJA from this version. Other mods adding products not checked

Updated for 1.6. Added some dialogue lines for certain products for Kent, Pam, Pierre, Linus, Gus and Wizard

French style brandy is now Cognac,  fruit wines produce Liquour, tequila is tequila añejo (you always aim at the best) (, Gin Rum and Sake have extra attributes.

Special version for use with RSV and Walk to the Desert coming later! 



[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Warning![/b][/size][/color]
If you have the previous version of this installed on a running game, sell all Gin, Rum, Sake, Vodka, (Moonshine), Absinthe (I hope I listed them all) you have in chests or inventory before updating to avoid losing them.

Installation: Just put the version of your choice to the mod folder.

I hope I put in all the dependencies. (the possible dependencies of dependencies are not listed)
